Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Round Wood Quadrant Hanging Wall Mirror, 15 Inch Height, Dark Wood Finish
Colors: Glass
Materials: wood
This modern mirror artfully combines wood and iron for hints of classic and industrial style. The circular mirror within the bold wooden frame makes it a striking addition to a bedroom, hallway, or mantel. 15" x 15" Modern design with rustic finishes Glass, wood, and metal Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included.
